content: We have fragments list, many are anionic etc. The task: "Extract its SMILES string efficiently". Likely we need to identify the molecule from fragments. That is more complex: a fused heterocycle (quinazoline?) with Cl. Does fragments list include that? Not directly but could be derived. The fragments list includes many anionic forms, but also "CCOC(=O)c1ccc(Nc2ccc(Cl)nc2)cc1". That is similar but not fused. Maybe the actual molecule is that simpler one.
